none: PAS FindID 1018253: Roman coin: nummus of Valentinian II
contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valentinian II (375-392), Emperor right, probably Arles mint, Reece period 19; RIC vol. 9 page 66 no. 18(c), issue of 375-378. Obverse description: Bust pearl diademed draped and cuirassed right, seem from front. Obverse inscription: [--]IANVS PF [AVG]. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right dragging captive and holding labarum. F [look like] D/h in field.…
